name: Nirbhay Singh
summary:

CNH Industrial. Skilled in driving process optimization, lean manufacturing, cost reduction, and quality
improvement through data-driven problem solving. Experienced in implementing Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream
Mapping (VSM), Standard Work, and KPI tracking across manufacturing operations. Adept at collaborating
cross-functionally to enhance productivity, eliminate waste, and sustain an operational excellence culture.
